title: Samson and Delilah
description: Delilah tricks Samson into revealing the secret of his strength. The Philistines cut his hair and capture him.

versions.title: Samson and Delilah
versions.description: Delilah tricks Samson into revealing the secret of his strength. The Philistines cut his hair and capture him.
versions.reason: [major] references: The existing story 'samsons-seier-og-dod' (Judges 16:21–31) is a subset of this proposed story (16:4–31). The new story covers the entire narrative with Delilah, the deception, captivity, and death in the temple of Dagon, while the existing one only covers the final part. These should be merged.
